Style: modern, Japandi, minimalist

Colors: medium grey, black
Shape: low wide body, thick padded arms on an exposed dark wood frame, two seat and back cushions, straight square legs, low and bulky

Goes with: white or concrete walls, light wood, black accents; Japandi or modern rooms

product.description: This chunky, oversized, mid-century-inspired modern design stands the test of time. With its squared shape and clean, simple lines, it can bridge the gap between classic and contemporary in your living room. 80.7"W x 37.8”D x 29.5”H Hardwood frame with reinforced corners At home in any room where a well-designed sofa is needed Simple assembly; just attach legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
